Module io.github.brantunger.unruly.core
Package io.github.brantunger.unruly.api.language

Class ConditionResult

java.lang.Object
io.github.brantunger.unruly.api.language.ConditionResult
public final class ConditionResult extends Object
What evaluating a condition returned, and, from a language that can explain it, why: the value, which must be a Boolean, and a detail. When the value is a Boolean, the engine records the detail on the rule's evaluation in the run's result, unless the run stops first; any other value fails the run, and the detail is dropped.

The detail is the language's own, such as the operands a comparison read or a trace of the subexpressions it evaluated. The engine doesn't read it, only keeps it, so a caller can read it after the run. That's after the run's session has gone back to the engine, to be used by another run or closed, so the detail must not be the Session or hold it, nor anything that reads from it later.

A result without a detail for true or false is one of two shared instances, so returning one allocates nothing.
